第13章 倾城之约密林幽会（第1页）
交换监察区域，两人口头协议，无真实凭据。
显然，是不打算再给沐倾城面子了。
陈离亦不再多言，冷冷扫了眼叶凡，随后驾驭青羽鹰腾空而起，消失在远处。
叶凡望着陈离离去的背影，耸了耸肩，转头对沐倾城笑道：“多谢三皇子妃出手相救。不过，你这么帮我，段天涯知道了，不会生气吧？”
沐倾城瞪了眼叶凡，强调道，“我刚说了，我所帮的，只是天武书院的规矩，不是你。”
叶凡神色有趣的笑了笑，“听陈离的意思，你先前都答应跟他交换监察区域了。现在会出现在这，难道不是因为特别关注我吗？”
沐倾城淡淡道，“我这趟过来，只是想求证一件事。”
叶凡眉毛轻挑了下，“这应该很明显了吧？陈离可是天武书院天榜前十的存在，能使唤动他的人可不多。至于段天涯为何要杀我，三皇子妃应该很清楚，无非就是杀子之仇嘛……”
沐倾城注视向叶凡道，“你手里有证据证明，林清月先前所怀，是段天涯的孩子吗？”
叶凡无奈地摊了摊手，“这事，当初我可是亲耳听段天涯、林清月说的。”
沐倾城摇了摇头道，“人证会说谎，但物证不会。”
叶凡嘴角含笑，意味深长道，“我想三皇子妃，心中都已经有答案了吧？”
“不是我需要证据，是沐家需要。”
沐倾城轻叹一声，一副心累的样子，“算了，跟你说不着这些。你有击败聂霖的实力，要通过新生试炼不难。得叮嘱你一句，等进入天武书院后，少惹事。”
奈何家族之意，父母之命，无法忤逆。
沐家一旦确认段天涯跟林清月有染，且致使林清月怀孕，必定不再支持段天涯。

没理由耗费精力扶段天涯夺得储君之位，最后让林家得了便宜。
叶凡故作一脸无辜，看向沐倾城戏谑道，“不过我要是不小心惹事了，三皇子妃还会帮我吗？”
“我不是很喜欢‘三皇子妃’这个称呼。”
沐倾城没有答应，似很抵触三皇子妃这个身份。
她有自己的名字，不是任何人的附属品。
叶凡眼眸一闪，笑意更浓了，“那……我该称呼你什么呢？沐师姐？倾城师姐？还是……倾城？”

The exchange of surveillance areas was a verbal agreement between the two, with no real evidence.
Obviously, he didn't intend to give Mu Qingcheng any more face.
Chen Li also said no more, glanced at Ye Fan coldly, then flew into the sky with a blue-feathered eagle and disappeared into the distance.
Ye Fan looked at Chen Li's leaving figure, shrugged, turned to Mu Qingcheng and smiled: "Thank you to the third prince for helping me. However, Duan Tianya won't be angry if you help me like this, right?"
Mu Qingcheng glared at Ye Fan and emphasized, "I just said that what I helped was only the rules of Tianwu Academy, not you."
Ye Fan smiled with an interesting expression, "According to Chen Li, you agreed to exchange surveillance areas with him before. Isn't it because you are here now because you pay special attention to me?"
Mu Qingcheng said calmly, "I came here just to verify one thing."
Ye Fan raised his eyebrows lightly, "This should be obvious, right? Chen Li is one of the top ten in Tianwu Academy, and there are not many people who can control him. As for why Duan Tianya wants to kill me, the third prince and concubine should know very well, it is nothing more than the revenge of killing his son..."
Mu Qingcheng looked at Ye Fan and said, "Do you have evidence in your hand to prove that Lin Qingyue was pregnant with Duan Tianya's child?"
Ye Fan spread his hands helplessly, "I heard Duan Tianya and Lin Qingyue say this with my own ears."
Mu Qingcheng shook her head and said, "Witnesses can lie, but physical evidence cannot."
With a smile on his face, Ye Fan said meaningfully, "I think the third prince and concubine already have the answer in her heart, right?"
"It's not that I need evidence, it's the Mu family that needs it."
Mu Qingcheng sighed softly, looking tired, "Forget it, I can't tell you this. You have the strength to defeat Nie Lin, and it is not difficult to pass the freshman test. I have to tell you not to cause trouble after entering Tianwu Academy."
However, the wishes of the family and the orders of the parents cannot be disobeyed.
Once the Mu family confirms that Duan Tianya has an affair with Lin Qingyue and makes Lin Qingyue pregnant, they will no longer support Duan Tianya.
There was no reason to expend energy on helping Duan Tianya win the crown prince position, which ultimately gave the Lin family an advantage.
Ye Fan pretended to be innocent, looked at Mu Qingcheng and joked, "But if I accidentally cause trouble, will the third prince help me?"
"I don't really like the title 'Third Princess'."
Mu Qingcheng did not agree and seemed to be very resistant to the status of the third prince's concubine.
She has her own name and is not anyone's accessory.
Ye Fan's eyes flashed and his smile grew stronger, "Then... what should I call you? Senior Sister Mu? Senior Sister Qingcheng? Or... Qingcheng?"
